title: Filed Sales Executive - Bangalore
jobDescription:
Ninjacart - Pioneer. Challenge Yourself. Create Better Lives. Ninjacart is a pioneer in agritech. We believe in fostering a culture of innovation. We develop professionals who pioneer new ideas, simplify customer experiences, and impact the lives of millions. Our employees take complete ownership and truly belong. Ninjacart is India's leading agri-platform, which leverages technology and data to organize the agri-commerce ecosystem. Over the last 8 years, our made-for-India technology and India-centric solutions have disrupted the way fruits and vegetables move from farms to consumers’ plates. We empower farmers and other players in the ecosystem in ways never done before. Ninjacart aims to be the digital network for global agri-commerce that solves structural problems such as information asymmetry, payment hassles, distribution inefficiency, and discovering new buyers and sellers with tech-first solutions. Ninjacart has raised over $350mn from Walmart Group, Tiger Global, Accel US, Accel India, Syngenta, and others. We are one of the top 25 startups to work for, according to Linkedin. We are a highly motivated, results driven community, who focus on proactive approaches to problem solving. We cherish entrepreneurial spirit and provide significant operating autonomy to senior leaders. There are ample opportunities and challenges to be solved at scale and in real-time.

Read More: ● #Better Lives For Every Agri Citizen https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7120720715909115905/

● How Ninjacart has evolved in the last 8 years: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J9Kts-O7tv4 ● Ninjacart Blog : https://www.ninjacart.com/blog/

● Nandan Nilekani on Ninjacart : https://www.linkedin.com/posts/ninja-cart_tech-pioneersatwork-ninjacart-activity-7027281166 617505792-pci W

● Ninjacart Culture CODE: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/ninja-cart_ninja-code-our-values-activity-70768214025483878 40-Ku L1 Location: Bangalore, KA

About the Team

The S&D vertical at Ninjacart is focused on the farm to retailer business of procuring from farmers and delivering to retailers - ensuring that farmers get paid the right price for their efforts and that retailers are able to get market quality produce delivered at their doorsteps. While this value proposition is solid and proven, it needs tweaking depending on the size of the town or the geography we operate it. As a part of the team, you will be in charge of sales and margins of the categories assigned to you. For this, you will need to understand our customers’ needs and will need to ensure that you are able to provide them the same at the right pricing and with the right value propositions. If the problem statements like understanding the market, creating the right assortment mix to target maximum customers, changing the same as per seasonality, engaging customers with virtual marketing, optimizing the source for the same leading to better margins, and overall adding to our customers’ profit excites you, then this is the opportunity for you.

Responsibilities

● Onboarding & managing retail outlets efficiently, in the assigned area

● Maintaining good relationship with the customers

● Collecting feedback from customers & communicating with the relevant teams to improve customer experience

● Achieving daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets

A Ninja is resilient, smart, and ambitious. Sounds like you? Here’s what you will need to have to join the Ninja Clan

● Any degree

● Should have android phone

● Should have two wheeler

● Willingness to travel within the assigned area

● Should be fluent with Kannada

Additional Information At Ninjacart, we are creating a workplace that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion irrespective of their background, gender, race, sexual orientation, religion and ethnicity. We are committed to providing equal opportunity for all and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer work environment that advances the goals of our employees, communities and the business.

title: Area Business Manager
location: Kolkata BU, Kolkata, West Bengal , India
jobDescription:
Ninjacart - Pioneer. Challenge Yourself. Create Better Lives.

India's leading agritech platform, Ninjacart (founded 2015) is revolutionising the $400B+ agri supply chain with tech-driven commerce, finance, and Supply chain solutions. We've served 200,000+ farmers and 60,000+ retailers & 5000+ Traders - slashed food spoilage by 30% —delivering fresh produce from farm to store in a record 14 hours. Over the last decade, our made-for-India technology and India-centric solutions have revolutionised the way fruits and vegetables reach consumers’ plates from farms on a daily basis.

We are backed by Walmart, Flipkart, Tiger Global, Accel, Syngenta & 1000+ Employees. Named Linked In's Top 25 Startups to Work For and winner of "Best Tech for Agriculture" at India Digital Enabler Awards 2025, we're building a global network for fresh fruits and vegetables —now expanding to Malaysia & Europe via Ninja Global.

Our Ninja CODE? Customer obsession, Ownership mindset, Dream Big & bold responsibility, and relentless innovation. Join a results-driven clan where autonomy fuels scale: Think big, act fast, impact millions.

About the ROLE:

We are seeking an experienced Area Business Manager to lead sales growth, manage key modern trade accounts, and strengthen our fruit category operations in Kochi and Kerala markets. The ideal candidate will have strong exposure to fresh produce with hands-on experience working directly with modern trade retailers.

Responsibilities

● Manage and grow business with direct modern trade customers

● Drive sales growth, category performance, and achieve regional revenue targets

● Build and execute joint business plans with modern trade partners

● Manage weekly targets, promotions, and in-store visibility

● Oversee stock planning, demand forecasting, and supply chain coordination

● Track seasonal trends, imported arrivals, and market price fluctuations

● Ensure product quality, shelf standards, and compliance across modern trade stores

●Conduct regular market visits and competitor analysis

● Identify new business opportunities within the fruit category

● Maintain strong internal coordination with operations, supply chain, and finance teams

Requirements:

● 5–8 years of experience in sales or procurement

● Strong experience in handling direct modern trade accounts

● Background in fruit, fresh produce, or FMCG food categories (mandatory)

● Experience working with importers is preferred

● Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills

● Good understanding of pricing, margins, and supply chain

The Potato BU is a key strategic sourcing category driving farm-gate procurement, trader partnerships, mandi intelligence, and cold storage linkages across major potato-growing clusters in Uttar Pradesh.

Responsibilities

● Establish strong sourcing network across farmers, traders, commission agents, and cold storages

● Onboard and manage sourcing vendors (including EKYC)

What You’ll Need

● Strong network in UP potato belt
● Deep understanding of mandi ecosystem and crop cycles
● Experience managing field teams
● Strong negotiation and commercial acumen
● MBA / Agri background preferred

title: Manager

jobDescription:
Operations Manager - Bangalore


Ninjacart - Pioneer. Challenge Yourself. Create Better Lives.


India's leading Fresh produce (Fruits and Vegetables) agritech platform, Ninjacart (founded 2015) is revolutionising the $400B+ agri supply chain with tech-driven commerce, finance, and Supply chain solutions. We aim to reduce food wastage, improve information asymmetry in trades and help reliable sellers find trusted buyers to make fresh produce agriculture more predictable and dependable. We've served 200,000+ farmers and 60,000+ retailers & and 5000+ Traders.


Over the last 10 years, our made-for-India technology and India-centric solutions have revolutionised the way fruits and vegetables reach consumers’ plates from farms daily. Eg: We move 300 tons of fresh produce from hundreds of farms to 20,000+ stores in a record 14 hours. We are backed by Walmart, Flipkart, Tiger Global, Accel, Syngenta & 1000+ Employees. Named Linked In's Top 25 Startups to Work For and winner of "Best Tech for Agriculture" at India Digital Enabler Awards 2025, we're building a global network for fresh fruits and vegetables —now expanding to Malaysia & Europe via Ninja Global. Our goal is to be a global leader in fresh produce commerce in the next 10 years.


Our Ninja CODE? Customer obsession, Ownership mindset, Dream Big & bold responsibility, and relentless innovation. Join a results-driven clan where autonomy fuels scale: Think big & impact millions.


To know more, please visit: www.ninjacart.com

Location: Bangalore , IND RESPONSIBILITIES:

We are looking for someone who has a keen inclination to analyze, evaluate, assess and provide market and competitive intelligence to Revenue teams and the Leadership at Ninjacart. You will maintain and manage contact with internal and external intelligence providers, hence developing a central view and knowledge-sharing process for insights into the identified market and the competitors.


● Partner with the senior leadership to drive top-down strategic initiatives across growth, expansion, and new opportunities

● Lead market intelligence and competitive intelligence efforts across agritech and adjacent ecosystems

● Develop a deep understanding of market structure, customer segments, competition, and emerging trends ● Apply thinking first principles to identify root causes of business problems and growth constraints

● Support growth strategy formulation including market entry, category expansion, pricing, and business model evaluation

● Build structured frameworks, dashboards, and narratives to enable leadership decision-making

● Work cross-functionally with Revenue, Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations teams to drive execution

● Prepare high-quality presentations, insights, and recommendations for leadership forums

● Travel on-ground to gain first-hand market and operational insights

● Take end-to-end ownership of strategic projects from problem definition to execution tracking

● Take up additional projects based on capability


A Ninja is resilient, smart, and ambitious. Sounds like you? Here’s what you will need to have to join the Ninja Clan


  • MBA or equivalent from a Tier 1/Tier 2 institute

  • 3-5 years of similar experience

  • Innovative thinker with analytical problem-solving skills

  • Ability to interpret large amounts of data and to multi-task

  • Strong experience in identifying, understanding, and leveraging 3rd party data to drive business insights

  • Ability to understand and analyze competitive and customer intelligence and insights in the Agritech space

  • Strong storytelling and communication skills with the ability to influence and enable the organization and cross-functional teams

  • Self-starter that is action and results-oriented. Able to prioritize, focus, and execute through obstacles

  • The ability to collaborate with cross-functional business partners to gather information and build consensus on strategic competitive positioning to drive results
